title: Require exact DAO builder scalar types
description: API correctness review finding in python/src/lichen/rpl/dao_manager.py lines 445-499: _build_dao checks only 0 <= path_lifetime <= 255, so bool values are accepted as lifetimes, floats pass the range check and later leak a raw bytes TypeError, and ack_requested is not required to be bool (DAO.to_bytes coerces arbitrary truthy values). Validate exact int/non-bool path_lifetime and exact bool ack_requested before constructing or signing a DAO; cover bool/float/truthy-object inputs.
